title: The Fatterflix Look
tagline: Deep red, warm cream and black turn my media library into one little cinema.
what: The visual system I designed across my Jellyfin library. The login, home screen, cards, details, drawers, dialogs and player all use the same deep-red, warm-cream and near-black cinema look.
built: Set the deep-red, warm-cream and near-black palette and carried it through the whole interface
Built the Fatterflix wordmark in CSS for the header and login screen instead of using an image
Restyled cards, detail pages, drawers, dialogs, progress states and the full player controls
Made design tokens so later login and home-screen pieces use the same surfaces, lines and elevation
progress: The login, library, details and player all carry the finished theme.

remix.changed: Designed the Fatterflix palette, wordmark, cards, details, dialogs, player, login and shared token system on top.

making.problem: The stock media server looked like a utility. I wanted every screen, from sign-in to playback, to feel like the same late-night cinema.
how: A small set of red, cream, black and surface tokens sets the visual language
The CSS wordmark and login card establish it before the library opens
Cards, details, dialogs and drawers reuse the same lines, glow and elevation
The player keeps the same type, progress and control treatment when the movie starts

broke.title: One field held the whole theme
broke.body: A later login change replaced that field, so I restored all 176,232 bytes and made the base-first order explicit.

credits: ElegantFin v25.11.25 is the visual base
Fatterflix palette, brand, components, player and login work by me

moment.what: The public sign-in page now opens on the same red line, cream type, black surface and CSS-built wordmark that carry through the library and player.
